probes.claim: Detect unintended document-level horizontal overflow at an exercised viewport.
probes.limitations: Does not prove local clipping, intended scrollers, or visual quality.

probes.claim: Exercise keyboard focus and detect missing or obscured focus on exercised controls.
probes.limitations: Cannot prove logical focus order for every workflow without scenario knowledge.

probes.claim: Exercise configured zoom or equivalent constrained CSS viewport and detect overflow/overlap assertions.
probes.limitations: Browser zoom semantics vary; retain environment metadata.

probes.claim: Exercise reduced-motion preference and assert configured motion invariants.
probes.limitations: Cannot judge whether remaining motion is cognitively appropriate.

probes.claim: Repeat a consequential action rapidly and verify domain operation cardinality and UI state.
probes.limitations: Requires application-specific observation of the domain effect.

probes.claim: Observe local, pending, persisted, rejected and conflicting transitions against authoritative persistence state.
probes.limitations: Requires an application adapter or test seam exposing authoritative state.

probes.claim: Interrupt connectivity, exercise recovery, and verify valid work and truthful status.
probes.limitations: Requires a workflow with a network dependency.

probes.claim: Expire authentication during work and verify safe recovery and permitted work preservation.
probes.limitations: Requires controllable authentication.

probes.claim: Perform the configured action and read the semantic state before animations settle; the state must already be correct.
probes.applyWhen: Any animated state change: selection, open/close, toggle, status.
probes.limitations: Reads configured DOM state only; application or domain truth that is not exposed in the DOM needs scenario evidence. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Repeat actions back to back and fail when concurrent animations stack on the same property of the same element, the final semantic state is wrong, or motion does not settle.
probes.applyWhen: Press feedback, selection indicators, toggles, anything users can activate quickly.
probes.limitations: Detects queued Web Animations/CSS transitions visible to document.getAnimations(); canvas or script-driven frame loops are invisible to it. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Interrupt a running transition with a second action and require convergence on the latest semantic and visual state.
probes.applyWhen: Any inertial or gravity transition that can be retargeted mid-flight.
probes.limitations: Visual convergence is checked only for configured readers. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and fail on spatial animations above a duration threshold or on repeated motion, while the final semantic state holds.
probes.applyWhen: Every surface that animates spatially or repeatedly.
probes.limitations: Cannot judge whether a remaining brief perceptual transition is cognitively appropriate; direct manipulation must opt in with allowSpatial. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Require focus to reach the expected element immediately after the action and to remain on a visible, non-inert element after the transition.
probes.applyWhen: Dialogs, popovers, menus, flyouts, route/view transitions, collapse/expand.
probes.limitations: Checks one expected focus target per scenario; full focus-order review stays manual. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Drive the pointer in steps and require the tracked visual to follow within a pixel tolerance on the next frame, with no transition smoothing the tracked position.
probes.applyWhen: Drag, resize handles, scrubbers, custom sliders and other pointer-driven mappings.
probes.limitations: Measures DOM geometry per rendered frame; it is not an input-latency or frame-timing benchmark. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Sample the visual progress fraction every frame across authoritative updates and fail if it ever exceeds the authoritative value plus tolerance.
probes.applyWhen: Determinate progress bars, meters and completion indicators.
probes.limitations: Requires readers for both values; it cannot validate the truthfulness of the authoritative value itself. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Start an activity, stop it, and require repeated animations in the activity region to stop and the status to report the stopped state.
probes.applyWhen: Spinners, skeleton shimmer, pulsing activity and other indeterminate indicators.
probes.limitations: Only sees animations exposed to document.getAnimations(); animated images and canvas loops are not observed. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Drag and drop into a rejected position and require the item to return to its authoritative position without any success presentation or state change.
probes.applyWhen: Reorder, drag-and-drop and any drop target that can refuse.
probes.limitations: Uses mouse events; keyboard reorder paths need their own scenario. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Sample a measured dimension every frame through settling and fail if it leaves the legal minimum/maximum.
probes.applyWhen: Resize, split panes, collapse/expand, snap points.
probes.limitations: Checks one configured measure per scenario. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Disable configured CSS @supports features and script APIs (for example document.startViewTransition), then require semantics and layout to remain correct.
probes.applyWhen: View Transitions, anchor positioning, scroll-driven animation, intrinsic-size interpolation and other progressive motion features.
probes.limitations: Feature removal is simulated by rewriting stylesheets and deleting APIs; genuinely older engines should still be exercised where supported. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: Trigger concurrent effects together and require each effect's final state; optionally fail on cancelled transitions.
probes.applyWhen: Elements that combine press, hover, selection, entry or drag effects.
probes.limitations: Final-state readers must be configured; intermediate visual interference is not judged. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.

probes.claim: With all animation and transition disabled, require the configured change to alter state attributes, text or static presentation of its target.
probes.applyWhen: Any state change whose meaning must not depend on motion alone.
probes.limitations: Checks presence of a non-motion cue, not whether that cue is sufficiently understandable. Engineering screen for one observable invariant; it does not prove universal human comfort, perceived smoothness or performance.
